en.headline: Elderly woman recovers after suspected choking in Yuen Long home
en.dek: Rescuers found the 87-year-old still breathing but unconscious after a report of a choking incident at about 5am in a Tai Hang Street unit.
body: Police received a report at about 5am on Saturday of a suspected choking at a unit inside Tai Hang Building on Tai Hang Street in Yuen Long. The unit is understood to be part of a residential care home.

Rescuers found the 87-year-old woman still had a pulse and was breathing but had lost consciousness. They took her to Pok Oi Hospital. She later regained consciousness, and police are investigating the circumstances.

The Fire Services Department has reminded the public that a conscious person who can cough forcefully should be encouraged to keep coughing. If the airway is completely blocked, call 999 and, if trained, perform abdominal thrusts. Do not give food or drink to someone who has lost consciousness.

zh.headline: 元朗院舍八旬婦疑鯁喉昏迷 送院後恢復清醒
zh.dek: 清晨約5時泰衡街大興大廈院舍單位內一名87歲老婦進食時疑鯁喉，仍有呼吸脈搏但陷入昏迷，其後清醒。
body: 警方周六清晨約5時接獲報案，指元朗泰衡街大興大廈一個院舍單位內有女子進食時懷疑鯁喉暈倒。
救援人員趕抵現場，發現87歲老婦仍有呼吸及脈搏，但已陷入昏迷，隨即送往博愛醫院治理。事後女事主回復清醒，警方正調查事故原因。
消防處提醒，如鯁喉者神志清醒並能用力咳嗽，應鼓勵對方繼續咳嗽；若氣道完全受阻，應立即致電999，並由懂得急救的人施行腹部推壓法。如患者已失去知覺，切勿餵食或飲水。
